title: Admission to the New Camp
description: POINT OF NO RETURN Chapter 1 - ENDING How to Start: Talk with [Mordrag](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=595509) and ask him for the escort to the New Camp Quest Steps: - REQUIRED Bring [Lares](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=596078) Supply List from the Old Mine during [Test of Faith](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=603835) Quest and complete [Something the Matter?](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=605734) Quest - Complete [Thirsty Farmers](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=595804) Quest - Complete [Up to His Neck](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=596142) Quest - Complete [The Dam Lurker](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=595814) Quest - Complete [A Piece of the Pie](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=605733) Quest - Complete [The Herb Merchant](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=598439) Quest - Complete [The Raid](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=605763) Quest Reward: - 1,000 XP - [Bandit's Dress ](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=605765) Next Quest: [The Brotherhood's Plan](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=607201) Note: [Admission to the Swamp Camp](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=595738) and [Admission to the Old Camp](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=595210) Quests will be failed once Lares allows the Hero to join the New Camp

title: Thirsty Farmers
description: Chapter 1 How to Start: Approach [Lefty](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=595803) while he's guarding peasants in the rice fields Quest Steps: - Get water from [Ulmar](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=595789) - Hand out water to 10 rice farmers - Report back to [Lefty](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=595803) - To complete this quest, beat up Lefty and tell him that it's his job to hand out water - ?? Reward: - 100 XP(every cycle) - 300 XP Next Quest: ??

title: A Few Drops Too Much
description: Chapter 1 How to Start: Talk to [Rice Lord](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=595806) and ask if he needs any help Quest Steps: - Talk to [Silas](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=596137) in [New Camp's Tavern](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=596132) - Deal with [Rayk](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=596136) - Report to [Silas](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=596137) - Report back to [Rice Lord](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=595806) Reward: - 400 XP - Ore Nugget x25(if confronted about his problems with Rayk) Next Quest: [Up to His Neck](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=596142)

title: The Dam Lurker
description: Chapter ?? How to Start: Talk to [Homer](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=595813) about the dam problems Quest Steps: - Find and kill the Lurker on the northern side of the lake - Report back to [Homer](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=595813) Reward: - 300 XP

title: A Roof Over My Head
description: Chapter 1 How to Start: Talk to [Gorn](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=595819) about a place to stay Quest Steps: - Beat up [Shrike](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=595822) and tell him to leave the hut - Report back to [Gorn](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=595819) Reward: - 100 XP - A hut to sleep in

title: Up to His Neck
description: Chapter 1 Quest Steps: - Ask [Malon](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=595809) about Bran - Beat up [Renyu](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=605346) to ge access to the [Bandit's Cave](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=605343) - Beat up [Jacko](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=605353) to learn more about Bran - Talk to [Silas](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=596137) about Bran - Get to the tavern basement by looking for an [entrance underwater](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=605362) - Locate [Bran's Corpse](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=605363) and his [Axe](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=605367) - Report back to [Rice Lord](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=595806) Reward: - 150 XP - 300 XP Previous Quest: [A Few Drops Too Much](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=595807)

title: Canvassing Customers
description: Chapter 1 How to Start: Talk to [Baal Kagan](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=596064) to help him peddle his swampweed Quest Steps: - Sell 10 Green Novices around the New Camp - Report back to [Baal Kagan](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=596064) Reward: - 200 XP Reward Options: - Ore Nugget x100 - [Dreamcall (Prepared)](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=598428) for [Baal Tyon](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=598283) approval - 3 Magic Scrolls: - Fist of Wind - Telekinesis - Pyrokinesis - Sleep - Charm

title: The Herb Merchant
description: Chapter 1 How to Start: Talk to [Baal Isidro](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=596133) after completing [Canvassing Customers](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=598418) Quest Quest Steps: - Sell enough of the product to [Cipher](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=596140) and give Baal Isidro 200 Ore Nuggets Reward: - 500 XP Note: Talk to [Lares](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=596078) to not miss [A Piece of the Pie](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=605733) Quest ??

title: A Piece of the Pie
description: Chapter 1 How to Start: Talk to [Lares](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=596078) before accepting [The Herb Merchant](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=598439) Quest for [Baal Isidro](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=596133) ?? after giving him the list?? title: Something the Matter?
description: Chapter 1 How to Start: Bring [Lares](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=596078) an [Ian's Supply List](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=603835) Quest Steps: - Bring the list to [Diego](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=595401) - Report back to [Lares](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=596078) Reward: - 750 XP Next Quest: [The Raid](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=605763)

title: The Raid
description: Chapter 1 How to Start: Complete [Something the Matter?](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=605734) Quest and talk to Lares Quest Steps: - Ask [Gorn](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=595819) for a better waepon - Meet [Wedge](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=605764) on the way between the Old Camp and the Old Mine - Finish the raid - Report back to [Lares](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=596078) Reward: - 500 XP

title: The Water Mages' Messenger
description: Chapter 2 How to Start: Talk to [Cronos](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=595825) after joining the [New Camp](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=595763) Quest Steps: - Deliver the letter to [Corristo](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=604027) by talking to [Milten](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=604020) - Report back to [Cronos](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=595825) Reward: - 200 XP - Ore Nugget x50 - Messenger's Amulet - Permits to go into the inner circle of the [New Camp](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=595701) and talk to Fire Mages

title: Joining the Mercenaries
description: Chapter 3 How to Start: Talk to [Lee](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=596109) about becoming a Mercenary after finishing [The Brotherhood's Plan](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=607201) Quest Quest Steps: - Meet with [Myxir](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=892212) by the [Old Lighthouse](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=596221) - Clear the beach of Fire Lizards with Myxir - Find [The Old Ways of the Druids](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=604265) in the underwater chest and bring it to Myxir - Report back to [Lee](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=596109) Reward: - 300 XP - after giving the book to Myxir - 700 XP - [Two Handed Training](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=596109) - [Mercenary's Armor](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=610649)

title: The Water Mages' Plan
description: Chapter 3 How to Start: Talk to [Gorn](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=595819)(New Camp member) by the waterfall next to the Old Mine or [Diego](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=595401)(Old Camp member) after compelting [The Brotherhood's Plan](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=607201) Quest Steps: - Meet with [Saturas](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=842102) and ask about Focus Stones - Meet at the meeting point right next to the [Fogtower](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=596221) Reward: - 500 XP - [Teleport to the Water Mages](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=889974) - Rune Next Quest: [The Focus Stones](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=889973)

title: The Rogues' Camp
description: Chapter 3 How to Start: Talk to [Lee](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=596109) / [Thorus](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=595406) abut a new job after completing [Joining the Mercenaries](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=610644) / [Joining the Warders](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=610571) Quest Quest Steps: - Talk to [Brannok](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=603853) to get [Bar the Truth](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=892336) Quest - Complete [Bar the Truth](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=892336) Quest - Talk to [Quentin](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=892399) - Report back to [Lee](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=596109) / [Thorus](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=595406) Reward: - 500 XP - after talking to [Quentin](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=892399) - 1,500 XP - Ore Nugget x100

title: The Focus in the Monastery Ruins
description: Chapter 3 How to Start: Aproach [Gorn](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=892227) by the [Monastery Ruins](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=595730) during [The Focus Stones](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=889973) Quest Quest Steps: - Clear the [Snapper Cave](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=608455) with Gorn and find [Transform into Meatbug](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=892224) Magic Scroll - Using [Transform into Meatbug](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=892224) Magic Scroll, crawl through a [small opening in a Monastery wall](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=892230) - Open the Gate for Gorn from the other side - Find and collect [Focus from Monastery Ruins](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=892226) at the end of the cave area with a [Shadowbeast](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=604076) - Give [Saturas](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=842102) the [Focus from Monastery Ruins](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=892226) Reward: - 3,000 XP - [Focus from Monastery Ruins](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=892226)

title: Initiation into the Circle of Water
description: Chapter 3 How to Start: Be a part of the [New Camp](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=595763), and become a [Mercenary](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=610644). Talk to [Saturas](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=842102) about joining a Circle of Water. Quest Steps: - Learn [Alchemy](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=864382) and [Inscription](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=849710) Skills - Talk to [Saturas](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=842102) about initiantion proceess - Head over to [Sunken Temple of Adanos ](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=892213) - Solve a simple puzzle by filling both columns with the same amount of water: fill the first column up to 4 reservoirs, then pull the lever to balance them - Report back to [Saturas](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=842102) Reward: - 200 XP - after learning [Alchemy](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=864382) - 200 XP - after learning [Inscription](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=849710) - 1,000 XP - [Water Robe](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=892325)

title: Xardas
description: Chapter 4 How to Start: After completing [Flames to the Flood](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=893834) Quest talk to [Saturas](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=842102) Quest Steps: - Head to the eastern path in the [Orc's Territory](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=605321) that leads to [Xardas' Tower](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=595732) - Talk to [Xardas Demon](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=893858) to learn how to access the [Xardas Tower](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=595732) - Defeat [Stone Golem](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=893851) using any Blunt Weapon and collect [Heart of A Stone Golem](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=893859) - Defeat [Ice Golem](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=893852) using any Fire Spells or Blunt Weapons and collect [Heart of an Ice Golem](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=893902) - Defeat [Fire Golem](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=893853) using any Ice Spells or Blunt Weapons and collect [Heart of a Fire Golem](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=893904) - Bring Golem Hearts to [Xardas Demon](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=893858) - Talk to [Xardas](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=595733) - Report back to [Saturas](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=842102) Reward: - 2,000 XP - after meeting [Xardas](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=595733) - [Teleport to the Necromancer](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=893905) - Rune Next Quest: [A Shaman Shunned](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=893932)

title: The Temple of Innos
description: Chapter 4 How to Start: Talk to [Nefarius](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=848523) Quest Steps: - Using [Climbing Skill](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=598297) reach the Tundra Area [above the Old Mine](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=603884) - Find the [Hidden Entrance](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=603916) behind the waterfall to the [Temple of Innos](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=892436) - Find and collect [Magic Runes and Rituals](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=603918) in the first chamber of the temple and [Innos' Grace](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=603922) above the temple's roof - Report back to [Nefarius](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=848523) Reward: - 1,500 XP - [Innos' Grace](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=603922) Next Quest: ??

title: The Minecrawler Armor
description: Chapter 4 Note: Armor can be collected from Wolf only after completing [The Banner of Banners](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=893946) Quest How to Start: Talk to [Wolf at the Free Mine's enrance](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=893843) about a new armor Quest Steps: - Collect Minecrawler Plates in the Free Mine - Talk to Wolf after at the on a path to the Free Mine - Receive the armor from Wolf after completing [The Banner of Banners](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=893946) Quest Reward: - 2,000 XP - after delivering Plates to Wolf - 1,000 XP - [Crawler Plate Armor](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=926877)

title: Recovering the Free Mine
description: Chapter 4 How to Start: Talk to Gorn at the Entrance to the Free Mine Quest Steps: - Clear the [Free Mine - Main Cave](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=605433) with Gorn Reward: - 1,000 XP Next Quest: [The Orc Enclave](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=926871)

title: A Letter from the Fire Mages
description: Chapter 1 Quest Steps: - Talk to [Milten](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=604020) - Give the letter to [Torrez](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=598436) Reward: - 200 XP - Reward Options: - Ring of Power +5 Strength - Essence of Spirit +2 Max Mana - Ring of Lesser Dexterity +5 Dexterity - Magic Scrolls ??

title: Admission to the Old Camp
description: POINT OF NO RETURN Chapter 1 - ENDING How to Start: Speak with Diego or Thorus about joining an Old Camp Quest Steps: - Complete [Casting Shadows](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=595408) - Complete [Test of Faith](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=603835) - Talk to [Thorus](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=595406) - Talk to [Gomez](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=604035) but don't mention Y'Berion, and join the Old Camp Reward: - 1,000 XP - [Shadow's Dress](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=604155) Next Quest: [The Brotherhood's Plan](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=607201) Note: [Admission to the New Camp](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=595763) and [Admission to the Swamp Camp](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=595738) Quests will be failed once Gomez allows the Hero to join the Old Camp

title: Out of Sight
description: Chapter 1 How to Start: Talk with [Thorus](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=595406) about his problems Quest Steps: - Find [Mordrag](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=595509) - Get rid of him by either beating him or escorting him to the New Camp - Report back to [Thorus](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=595406) Reward: - 300 XP - [Mordrag's Ring](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=595759)(optional)

title: Casting Shadows
description: Chapter 1 How to Start: Speak with [Diego](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=595401) after conversation with [Thorus](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=595406) Quest Steps: - Earn enough reputation points by completing the most influential people's Quests in the Outer Ring of the Old Camp - Earn Thorus's approval by completing [Out of Sight](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=595407) - Earn Sly's approval by completing [The Vanished Warder](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=595419) - Earn Fingers' approval by completing [A Ring for Fingers](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=595572) - Earn Dexter's approval by completing [The Cult's Recipe](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=595500) - Earn Whistler's approval by completing [Whistler's Sword](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=595482) - Earn Fisk's approval by completing [A New Fence for Fisk](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=596146) Next Quest: [Test of Faith](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=603835)

title: The Vanished Warder
description: Chapter 1 How to Start: Talk with [Sly](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=595418) about a "Job" after having a conversation with [Diego](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=595401) Quest Steps: - Speak with [Fletcher](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=595537) to learn more about Nek(optional) - Speak with [Guy](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=595559) to learn more about Nek(optional) - Speak with [Snaf](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=595577) to learn more about Nek(optional) - Find [Nek](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=595718) in a small cave just outside the South Gate of the Old Camp - Bring [Amulet of the Dead Guard](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=595717) back to [Sly](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=595418) to earn his approval or keep the amulet Reward: - 250 XP - [Amulet of the Dead Guard](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=595717)(optional)

title: The Price of Magic
description: Chapter 1 How to Start: Talk with [Torrez](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=595473) about becoming a Fire Mage Quest Steps: - Acquire Blank Parchment, which can be bought from [Graham](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=595256) - Acquire 2 Wolf's Claws, which can be bought from [Mordrag](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=595760) - Bring materials back to [Torrez](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=595474) - Learn Rune Magic(Novice Magician) Reward: - 250 XP - - Single Rune: - Healing Rune - Firebolt Rune Next Quest: ??

title: Whistler's Sword
description: Chapter 1 How to Start: Speak with [Whistler](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=595477) Quest Steps: - Speak with [Fisk](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=595502) but don't mention the old price of 100 Ore Nuggets or Quest will be FAILED - Buy the sword for 110 Ore Nuggets and bring the sword back to [Whistler](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=595477) Reward: - 200 XP - Whistler's approval to join the Old Camp Next Quest: ??

title: The Cult's Recipe
description: Chapter 1 How to Start: Talk with [Dexter](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=595489) about becoming the Shadow Quest Steps: - Sneak into [Cor Kalom's Laboratory](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=596163) at night and steal the [recipe](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=598241) from the [Locked Chest](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=598209) that's located near his Alchemy Tables - Bring the Kalom's Recipe back to Dexter - ?? Reward: - 350 XP - Dreamcall x3 - Dexter's approval Next Quest: ??

title: The Forgotten Recipe
description: Chapter 1 How to Start: Collect Quest Steps: - Talk with a Camp's Cook [Snaf](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=595577) about the found recipe - Bring to Snaf: - Scavenger Breast x2 - [Potato](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=595489) x2 - [Onion](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=595489) x2 - [Carrot](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=595489) x2 - [Solanaceae](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=595744) x2 - [Water](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=595256) x2 - Using Cauldron, cook Brock's Stew - Bring Brock's Stew to Snaf Reward: - 100 XP - [Brock's Stew Recipe](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=595753)

title: Impress Scatty
description: Chapter 1 How to Start: Talk with [Scatty](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=595556) about gaining his respect Quest Steps: - Choose either [Kirgo](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=595557) or [Kharim](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=595532) to fight Reward: - 200 XP - Scatty's approval if: - Kirgo is defeated - Challenged Kharim and won/lost Next Quest: ?? Note: If a fight with Kirgo is lost, your reputation goes down a little

title: A Ring for Fingers
description: Chapter 1 How to Start: Speak with [Fingers](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=595571) and ask him about his approval Quest Steps: - ?? Reward: - 100 XP - Fingers' approval

title: Snaf's Recipe
description: Chapter 1 How to Start: Ask [Snaf](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=595577) about his new recepie Quest Steps: - Find Bugmeat x3 - Find Hellcap x5 Reward: - 100 XP - Meatbug Ragout - [Meatbug Ragout Recipe](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=595755)

title: The Amulet
description: Chapter 1 How to Start: Talk with [Grim](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=595590) Quest Steps: - Refuse to pay [Bloodwyn](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=595414) protection fee - Wait until Grim asks to seek the Amulet Reward: - 200 XP Note: If diggers were slain - wait for 24h for guards to forget about a fight

title: A New Fence for Fisk
description: Chapter 1 How to Start: Beat up Mordrag [Mordrag](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=595509) and make him leave the Old Camp Quest Steps: - Talk to [Sharky](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=596061) to become a new Fence for Fisk - Report back to [Fisk](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=595502) Reward: - Fisk's approval - 300 XP

title: Test of Faith
description: Chapter 1 IMPORTANT: If the Supply List is given to Diego, there is no way to get it to [Lares](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=596078) to join [New Camp](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=595763) and start [Something the Matter?](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=605734) Quest How to Start: Speak with [Diego](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=595401) after completing 3 quests during [Casting Shadows](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=595408) Quest Steps: - Get supply list from [Ian](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=603952) in the [Old Mine](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=595727) by telling him a password - Bring the Supply List to [Diego](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=595401) or [Lares](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=596078), depending on which camp you plan to join Reward: - 750 XP - Diego's approval

title: Special Pieces
description: Chapters 1-3 How to Start: Talk to [Santino](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=603932) in the Old Mine Quest Steps: - While completing [The Focus at the Mountain Fortress](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=892351) Quest, right after opening a Secret Door - talk to Lester and collect the [Certificate(Title Deed)](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=892355) by agreeing to find a buyer - Bring the Certificate(Title Deed) to [Santino in the Old Camp](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=892192) - Accept his offer Reward: - Ore Nugget x1,000 - 750 XP - [Santino's Key](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=892198)

title: Bully for Bullit
description: Chapter 1 How to Start: Talk to [Syra](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=603976) about her problems Quest Steps: - Beat up Bullit - Report back to [Syra](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=603976) Reward: - 175 XP - beating up [Bullit](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=603981) - 500 XP Next Quest: [Secrets](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=607902)

title: Double, Double
description: Chapter 2 How to Start: Talk to [Snaf](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=595577) Quest Steps: - Talk to [Syra](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=603976) and complete a [Bully for Bullit](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=603977) Quest - Report back to [Syra](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=603976) and ask for a Recipe - Give Syra's Recipe to [Snaf](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=595577) - Find: - Carrot x2 - Strong Beer x2 - Raw Meat x2 - Mistcap x2 - Cavern Dewleaf x2 - Wait for Snaf to finish cooking the dish Reward: - [Syra's Baron Stew Recipe](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=607205)

title: Secrets
description: Chapter 2-3 How to Start: Complete [The Lost Apprentice](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=607224), [Bully for Bullit](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=603977) Quests and talk to [Syra](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=603976) about her problems in the Old Camp Quest Steps: - Talk to [Chani](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=607310) in Chapter 3 - Report back to [Syra](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=603976) - Tell [Seraphia](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=604033) and [Velaya](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=714946) about a Swamp Camp - Report back to [Syra](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=603976) Reward: - 100 XP - after convincing Seraphia - 100 XP - after convincing Velaya - 500 XP Notes: - BUG Completing [The Great Awakening](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=607873) Quest will fail this Quest - Currently, the quest is bugged, and it's tricky to finish it if NOT a part of the Old Camp - The Transform into Meatbug spell can be used to get past the guards into the main castle building to talk to Velaya and Seraphia - in the evening between 10:30 pm til 11:00 pm both women go to Gomez room (the one with the bathtub) and are open to talking until 1:00 am (consider, it completely changes after the castle massacre in chapter 4) - Suggest a way around for this quest if there are any other options :-)

title: Joining the Warders
description: Chapter 3 IMPORTANT NOTE: It is impossible to be a [Warder](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=610571) and a [Fire Mage](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=889976) at the same time! How to Start: Talk to [Thorus](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=595406) about becoming a Warder after finishing [The Brotherhood's Plan](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=607201) Quest Quest Steps: - Take 3 Diggers and escort them to the Exchange Zone - Meet with [Kirgo in the Exchange Zone](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=892651) and help him defend the site - Report back to [Thorus](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=595406) Reward: - 700 XP - [Warder's Armor](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=610572)

title: The Templar's Blade
description: Chapters 2-3 How to Start: Learh Smithing(Trained) from [Huno](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=595546), complete [The Lurker's Bite](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=891656) Quest and learn Smithing(Master) from [Stone](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=603996) Quest Steps: - Talk to [Gor Na Zar](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=598288) about his blade - To get [Gor Na Zar's](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=598288) weapon, try to convince [Darrion](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=598382) to give the Recipe by forging him a Light Two-Hander (schematic is available in his shop) - Give the crafted Light Two-Hander Sword to Darrion - Craft a War Sword and give it to [Stone](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=603996) Reward: - 500 XP - Ore Nugget x70 - War Sword Recipe Notes: - Possible to give him the [War Sword](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=607543) from the [Black Goblin Cave](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=595723)?? - [Stone](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=603996) can give the Light Two-Hander for free Next Quest: [Forged Rivalries](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=892438)

title: Trial of Fire
description: Chapter 3 IMPORTANT NOTE: It is impossible to be a [Warder](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=610571) and a [Fire Mage](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=889976) at the same time! How to Start: Be a part of the [Old Camp](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=595210) and become a [Warder](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=610571). Talk to [Milten](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=604020) about becoming a Fire Mage, and read the Rituals of the Order of Fire Quest Steps: - Learn [Alchemy](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=604024), and [Inscription](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=595473) Skills - Answer to [Corristo's](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=604027) first question with "I want to bring justice and help people" - Answer to [Corristo's](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=604027) second question with "It's our faith in Innos" - Ignite the [Shrine of Innos behind the waterfall](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=892204) and the [Shrine on the cliff](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=892205) with Pray to Innos Magic Scrolls - Report back to [Corristo](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=604027) to join the Circle of Fire Reward: - 200 XP - Igniting the Shrine of Innos - 200 XP - Igniting the Shrine of Innos - 1,000 XP - [Fire Robe](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=892206) - [Fire Mages Chambers Key](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=892767) - Free [Fire Bolt](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=892207) or Healing rune(depends on what you chose during [The Price of Magic](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=595475) Quest) from [Drago](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=604026)

title: The Lurker's Bite
description: Chapters 1-3 How to Start: Learn [One-Hand Smithing](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=595546) and wait for a cpuple of days(or 24h??) Quest Steps: - Talk to [Huno](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=595546) - Forge 5 Sickles for Fisk - Bring Sickles to [Fisk](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=595502) - Report back to [Huno](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=595546) Reward: - 100 XP - The Lurker's Bite Recipe + Materials

title: The Focus in the Troll Canyon
description: Chapter 3 How to Start: Aproach [Milten](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=892337) during [The Focus Stones](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=889973) Quest Quest Steps: - Give Milten [Troll Skin x3](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=892341) - Wait for Milten to make a Shrink Monster Magic Scroll - Use Shrink Monster Magic Scroll on [Adult Troll](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=892232) and kill him - Open the main gate with Milten by pulling two levers right next to it - Using the [Telekinesis](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=892349) Spell, make a bridge to reach and collect [Focus from Troll Canyon](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=892350) - Give [Saturas](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=892329) the [Focus from Troll Canyon](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=892350) Reward: - 2,000 XP - after killing [Adult Troll](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=892232) - 3,000 XP - [Focus from Troll Canyon](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=892350)

title: The Focus Below The Stone Circle
description: Chapter 3 How to Start: Aproach [Diego](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=893735) by the [Stonehenge](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=595726) during [The Focus Stones](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=889973) Quest Quest Steps: - Open the [Stonehenge Tunnel](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=893740) by lighting up 4 stone torches - Clear the underground part of the [Stonehenge](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=595726) with Diego - Kill a Zombie with an electric trap by activating it with ranged weapons - Collect [Focus from Stone Circle](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=893734) - Give [Saturas](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=842102) the [Focus from Stone Circle](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=893734) Reward: - 3,000 XP - [Focus from Stone Circle](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=893734)

title: Between a Rock and a Hard Place
description: QUEST IS CURRENTLY BUGGED Chapter 5 How to Start: Talk to [Darrion](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=607899) or Find Stone in the Old Camp's Dungeons, in the same cell as [Arlin](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=892384) was. [Santino's Secret Passage](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=596148) is the easiest way to get to him Quest Steps: - Fletcher can be bribed at the North Gates to walk freely in the courtyard - Find Stone in one of the cells of the Old Camp's Dungeons by going through a [Santino's Secret Passage](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=596148) - Escort Stone to help him escape the Old Camp Reward: - 1,000 XP - after helping him escape - 1,000 XP - after talking to him in the Swamp Camp's Smithy - Reward Options: - Heavy Two-Hander - Free armor Alteration Shadowbeast Breastplate - Ring of Lesser Invincibility - Ring of Greater Life - Amulet of Enlightenment

title: Escape Plan
description: Chapters 3-6 How to Start: Quest starts right after Gomez kills Fire Mages, or after finding Syra's body and reading a note after escaping with Milton Quest Steps: - Good Ending(Everyone survives): - Before starting the [Flames to the Flood](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=893834) Quest, talk to [Chani](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=607310) in the Swamp Camp - Don't escape with Milton during the [Flames to the Flood](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=893834) Quest - Fight your way through and talk to [Syra](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=603976), [Velaya](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=714946) and [Seraphia](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=604033) - Bad Ending(Velaya survives): - Talk to [Velaya](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=714946) and [Seraphia](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=604033) in Gomez' room Reward: - Good Ending: - 1,500 XP - After saving Syra - 1,500 XP - After saving Velaya - 1,500 XP - After saving Seraphia - Bad Ending: - 1,500 XP - After saving Velaya

title: New Souls for the Brotherhood
description: Chapter 1 How to Start: Speak with [Dusty](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=595520) Quest Steps: - Talk to [Melvin ](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=598376) and [Baal Tondral](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=598377) at the [Swamp Camp](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=595698) - Escort Dusty to [Baal Tondral](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=598377) by bribing the Gate Guard for 100 Ore Nuggets Reward: - 250 XP for bribing a guard - 500 XP - [Baal Tondral](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=598377) approval

title: Admission to the Swamp Camp
description: POINT OF NO RETURN Chapter 1 - ENDING How to Start: Talk to [Lester](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=596159) after trying to speak with any guru in the camp Quest Steps: - Talk to [Cor Kalom](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=598196) - Get support from 4 out of 5 possible gurus - Ask [Lester](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=596159) how to earn the support of [Baal Namib](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=596160) while he's away from him, and then ask him to go back to the main gate and renounce the old gods - Get [Baal Cadar's](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=596162) approval by using [Sleep Scroll](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=598391) on any novice around him - Get [Baal Orun's](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=598163) approval by completing the [Swampweed Harvest](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=598309) Quest - Get [Baal Tyon's](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=598283) approval by giving him a [Prepared Dreamcall](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=598428) after completing [Canvassing Customers](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=598418) Quest - Get [Baal Tondral's](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=598377) approval by completing [New Souls for the Brotherhood](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=595521) Quest - Talk to [Cor Kalom ](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=598196) about joining the Brotherhood with the reason that "Sleeper's power set all free" Reward: - 200 XP - Baal Namib's approval - 200 XP - Baal Cadar approval - 200 XP - Baal Orun approval - 200 XP - Baal Tyon approval - 200 XP - Baal Tondral approval - 750 XP - [Novice's Armor](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=605735) Next Quest: ?? Note: [Admission to the New Camp](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=595763) and [Admission to the Old Camp](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=595210) Quests will be failed once Y'Berion allows the Hero to join the Swamp Camp

title: Ghorim's Replacement
description: Chapter 1 How to Start: Talk to [Ghorim](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=598170) Quest Steps: - Convince [Harlok](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=598301) to relieve [Ghorim](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=598170) by beating him up - Report back to [Ghorim](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=598170) Reward: - 300 XP Next Quest: [Swampweed Harvest](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=598309)

title: Aiming High
description: Chapter 1 How to Start: Speak with [Theron](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=598297) about his favorite resting spot Quest Steps: - Bring 6 Northern Dark rolls, which can be bought from [Fortuno](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=598303) - Learn Climbing from Theron - Climb cliffs with Theron Reward: - 100 XP - Wall Climbing Lesson - Northern Dark x3

title: Swampweed Harvest
description: Chapter 1 How to Start: Complete [Ghorim's Replacement](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=598176) Quest and approach [Baal Orun](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=598163) Quest Steps: - Pick up harvest from [Balor](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=598312) - Help [Viran](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=598346) with his Bloodflies problem and pick up the swampweed from him - Report back to [Baal Orun](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=598163) - Deliver Swampweed to [Cor Kalom](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=598196) Reward: - 100 XP - After picking up harvest from Balor - 500 XP - After picking up harvest from Viran - 200 XP - 100 XP - After delivering swampweed to Cor Kalom - 200XP and [Sleep Magic Scroll](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=598391) after talking to Baal Orun after delivering swampweed - Baal Orun's approval Next Quest: ??

title: The Lost Apprentice
description: Chapter 2 How to Start: Talk to [Cor Kalom](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=598196) about Caine Quest Steps: - Find [Drawing of Abandoned Mine](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=607214) in the Caine's hut - Show the Drawing to [Lester](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=596159) - Access [Abandoned Mine](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=604072) by convincing [Orry](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=604069) with either giving him 200 Ore Nuggets, Dreamcall, or beating him up - Open the gate in the flooded area by finding [Detached Winch](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=607260) underwater - Find [Caine](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=607289) at the end of the [Abandoned Mine](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=607255) - Report back to [Cor Kalom](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=598196) with [Strange Amulet](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=607285) Reward: - 1.000 XP - Ore Nugget x50 Next Quest: [Y'berion](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=607307)

title: Y'berion
description: Chapter 2 How to Start: Complete [The Lost Apprentice](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=607224) Quest Steps: - Meet [Y'berion](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=607316) Reward: - 200 XP Next Quest: [The Focus Stone](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=607323)

title: The Focus Stone
description: Chapter 2 How to Start: Complete [Y'berion](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=607307) Quest Quest Steps: - Talk to [Nyras](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=598249) - Walk with Nyras to get [Focus from Ocean Cliff](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=607411) - Report back to [Y'berion](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=607316) Reward: - 750 XP - [Amulet of Flames](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=607478) Next Quest: [The Almanac](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=607482)

title: The Almanac
description: Chapter 2 How to Start: Complete [The Focus Stone](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=607323) Quest and talk to [Y'berion](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=607316) about new errands Quest Steps: - Talk to [Milten](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=604020) to learn where the Almanac is - Retrieve the [Almanac](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=595724) from the [Black Goblin Cave](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=595723) - Bring the Almanac to [Y'berion](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=607316) - Meet with [Cor Kalom](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=598196) Reward: - 2,500 XP - Reward Options: - Extract of Magic Energy x5 - Ore Nugget x150 - Sleep x3 - Magic Scroll Next Quest: [The Minecrawler Nest](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=607663)

title: The Minecrawler Nest
description: Chapter 2 How to Start: Complete [The Almanac](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=607482) Quest and talk to [Cor Kalom](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=598196) Quest Steps: - Ask [Cor Kalom](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=598196) for additional Light Scrolls and Healing potions - Talk to [Cor Angar](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=598367) - Defeat [Gor Na Dun](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=598362) - Bribe [Drake](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=603931) at the Old Mine entrance to get through with 100 Ore Nuggets(if a part of New Camp) - Find and talk to [Lester in the Old Mine](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=607740) - Get [Ian's](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=603952) permission to clear the collapsed tunnel by helping him find the [Cog](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=603966) during [Cog in The Wheel](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=607768) Quest - Find [Gor Na Vid](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=603960)(bring a Dreamcall), [Gor Na Kosh](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=603959) and [Gor Na Bar](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=603957)(bring 4 Minecrawler's Mandibles) in the Old Mine to help with the collapsed tunnel - Report back to Lester at the entrance to the Old Mine about Ian's decision - Follow Diego to try to convince Ian - Use Explosive Barrel and Explosion spell given by Gorn and Milten to clear the [Collapsed Tunnel](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=607738) - Defeat the [Minecrawler Queen](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=607800) - Bring [Cor Kalom](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=598196) Minecrawler Eggs Reward: - 150 XP - after defeating Gor Na Dun - Extract Secretion - Skill - 250 XP - after giving a Dreamcall to [Gor Na Vid](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=603960) - 250 XP - after giving 4 Minecrawler's Mandibles to [Gor Na Bar](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=603957) - 1,500 XP - after clearing a Collapsed Tunnel - 2,000 XP - after defeating [Minecrawler Queen](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=607800) - 2,500 XP Next Quest: [The Great Awakening](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=607873)

title: The Great Awakening
description: Chapter 2 How to Start: Complete [The Minecrawler Nest](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=607663) Quest and talk to Y'berion and Cor Kalom Quest Steps: - Attend a ceremony at night at the [Temple Square](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=596164) - Check on Y'berion Reward: - 300 XP - Ring of Wooden Skin - Point Protection +5 Next Quest: [Orc Cemetery](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=607901)

title: Swampweed Monopoly
description: Chapter 2 How to Start: Be a part of the [Brotherhood](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=595738) and talk to [Cor Kalom](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=598196) Quest Steps: - Locate the lab near the [New Camp](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=595689) - Either threat or beat up [Jacko](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=605353) and mixers or take a bribe from them - Report back to [Cor Kalom](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=598196) Reward: - 750 XP Note: Completing [The Great Awakening](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=607873) Quest will fail this Quest

title: Herb Delivery
description: Chapter 2 How to Start: Be a part of the [Brotherhood](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=595738) and talk to [Cor Kalom](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=598196) Quest Steps: - Deliver Dreamcalls to [Bartholo](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=604032) and collect 500 Ore Nuggets - Bring 500 Ore Nuggets to [Cor Kalom](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=598196) Reward: - 200 XP Notes: - Completing [Swampweed Monopoly](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=607888) Quest will fail this Quest - Completing [The Great Awakening](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=607873) Quest will fail this Quest

title: Orc Cemetery
description: Chapter 2 - ENDING How to Start: Complete [The Great Awakening](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=607873) and talk to Cor Angar Quest Steps: - Ask [Talas](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=598287) to show the path to the [Orc Cemetery](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=595725) - Find [Baal Lukor at the Orc Cemetery](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=749380) - Get inside the Main Chamber by unlocking [Orc Cemetery Locked Door](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=757773) with Orc Graveyard Key by combining [Half a Key 1](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=770990) and [Half a Key 2](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=784707) - Collect [Focus from Ocean Cliff](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=753878) and report back to Cor Angar in the [Temple of the Sleeper](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=596164) Reward: - 2,000 XP - [Teleport to the Swamp Camp](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=821372) - rune Next Quest: Second part of the [The Brotherhood's Plan](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=607201)

title: Joining the Templars
description: Chapter 3 How to Start: Talk to [Cor Angar](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=598367) about becoming a Templar after finishing [Orc Cemetery](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=607901) Quest Quest Steps: - ?? Reward: - ?? XP - [Templar's Armor](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=610742) Next Quest: ??

title: The Focus at the Mountain Fortress
description: Chapter 3 How to Start: Aproach [Lester](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=892352) during [The Focus Stones](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=889973) Quest Quest Steps: - Kill [Bridge Golem](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=892233) using any Blunt Weapon - Clear the first two floors of the Mountain Fortress with Lester - Open a [Secret Passage](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=892356) behind the fireplace by interacting with the bookshelves in the right order: Swampshark -> Wolf -> Molerat - Collect [Focus from Mountain Fortress](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=892354) by accesing it through a Third Floor of the Fortress - Give [Saturas](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=892329) the [Focus from Mountain Fortress](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=892354) Reward: - 500 XP - after defeating [Bridge Golem](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=892233) - 3,000 XP - [Focus from Mountain Fortress](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=892354)

title: Forged Rivalries
description: Chapters 2-3 How to Start: Talk to [Darrion](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=598382) after delivering the War Sword to Stone during [The Templar's Blade](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=610733) Quest Quest Steps: - Collect [Royal Weapon Design](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=604038) from the chest next to the [Gomez'](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=604035) throne and bring it to [Stone](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=603996) - Bring Materials to Stone or give him 1,000 Ore Nuggets - Steel x5 - Iron x2 - Iron Wood x2 - Leather Strips x2 - Wait for Stone to forge a weapon - Show Warhammer to [Darrion](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=598382) Reward: - 500 XP - after giving Design to Stone - [Warhammer](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=893711) - Schematic of Warhammer - 350 XP Next Quests: [Between a Rock and a Hard Place](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=894935) Note: [Warhammer](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=893711) can be forged by Stone 2 times with Materials and then with 1,000 Ore Nuggets BEFORE giving the weapon to Darrion

title: Point of No Return
description: Chapter 3-6 How to Start: Talk to Viran Quest Steps: - Convince the Balor and Joru to escape the Orc Cemetery Camp - Distract the guard by either casting a Sleeping spell or just talking to him - Escort novices safely out of the camp - Talk to Viran Reward: - 250 XP - after convincing Balor - 250 XP - after convincing Joru - 750 XP

title: Beasts of Khorinis IV
description: Chapters 1-6 How to Start: Pick up [The Bestiary of Khorinis IV](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=598342) Quest Steps: - Bring it to [Cavalorn](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=595691) - Bring Swampshark Hide and Plates - they can be found near [Swamp Camp](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=595698) Reward: - 1,000 XP - Ore Nugget x250 - Swampshark Skin harvesting Skill

title: Beasts of Khorinis II
description: Chapters 1-6 How to Start: Pick up [The Bestiary of Khorinis II in the Old Mine](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=603941) or in the [Wolf's Hut](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=893842) Quest Steps: - Bring it to [Cavalorn](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=595691) - Bring [Cavalorn](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=595691) [Queen's Pheromone Gland](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=607810) Reward: - 500 XP - after collecting the [Queen's Pheromone Gland](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=607810) - 500 XP - Extract Organ harvesting Skill

title: Aaron's Chest
description: Chapters 1-6 How to Start: Talk to [Snipes](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=603944) Quest Steps: - Lure Aaron away from his [chest](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=603947) by telling him that Ian wants to see him - Report back to [Snipes](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=603944) and buy Aaron's Chest Key for 30 Ore - Make [Aaron](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=603946) buy his key back Reward: - 150 XP - Ore Nugget x10

title: Ulbert's Storage Shed
description: Chapters 1-6 How to Start: Ask [Ulbert](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=603948) about what he's guarding Quest Steps: - Offer a beer to Ulbert and speak with him again - Get a Key from [Aleph](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=603937) for 30 Ore - Return to Ulbert and send him away to Ian - Open the Locked Storage Shed Chests Reward: - 75 XP - [Locked Storage Shed Chest](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=603950) - [Locked Storage Shed Chest](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=603951)

title: The Gloves Are Off
description: Chapters 1-6 How to Start: Talk to [Jan](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=604278) Quest Steps: - Buy Remedy from [Cronos](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=595761) - Bring it back to [Jan](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=604278) Reward: - 250 XP

title: Beasts of Khorinis I
description: Chapters 1-6 How to Start: Collect [The Bestiary of Khorinis I](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=604287) Quest Steps: - Bring it to [Cavalorn](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=595691) - Complete a test with [Cavalorn](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=595691) on [The Bestiary of Khorinis I](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=604287) book Reward: - 50 XP - Hunting Skill - Skull Armor Removal

title: Beasts of Khorinis III
description: Chapters 1-6 How to Start: Collect [The Bestiary of Khorinis III](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=603833) Quest Steps: - Bring it to [Cavalorn](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=595691) - Collect Lizard's Bone Scute from Lizards - Bring Lizard's Bone Scute to [Cavalorn](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=595691) Reward: - 850 XP - Fins harvesting Skill

title: Beak Performance
description: Chapters 1-6 How to Start: Talk to [Cohsel](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=596143) once about scavenger riding, and ask him a few in-game days later again Quest Steps: - Bring [Cohsel](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=596143) 5 Kingstide algae - Bring 3 Wolf's Skins and 2 Leather Strips for Scavenger Saddle - Talk to Cohsel after waiting for 24 hours Reward: - 300 XP - Scavenger Whistle - Scavenger Riding Skill

title: Baloro's Weapon
description: Chapters 1-3 How to Start: Talk to [Baloro](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=605420) Quest Steps: - Bring Baloro: - Apple x5 - Rice Schnapps x2 - Beer x5 - Bread x3 - Cheese x2 - Grapes x2 Reward: - 300 XP - No Weapon :( Note Can be beaten up after confronting him for not rewarding you, to get all the food back and his [weapon](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=605422)

title: The Stranger
description: Chapters 1-6 How to Start: Find and read [Chromanin I ](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=892210)in the [FogTower](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=596221) catacombs Quest Steps: - Find and Collect books in sequential order - Find [Chromanin I](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=892210) in the [Fogtower](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=596221) - Find [Chromanin II](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=892216) in the fisherman's hut - Find [Chromanin III](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=892219) in the [Mountain Fortress](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=595731) - Find [Chromanin IV](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=892220) in a torture chamber of the [Old Camp's Dungeons Area](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=607504) - Find [Chromanin V](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=892221) underneath an Old Citadel - Find [Chromanin VI](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=892211) in the same catacoms area of the [Fogtower - Lighthouse](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=596221) Reward: - ?? XP - after reading Chromanin I - ?? XP - after reading Chromanin II - 700 XP - after reading Chromanin III - 850 XP - after reading Chromanin IV - 1,000 XP - after reading Chromanin V - [Open Chest - The Stranger Quest](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=926858) - Parchment x5 - Elixir of Magic Energy - [Inscription of Transform Into Shadowbeast](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=926861) - [Ring of Greater Invincibility](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=926860) - [Storn of Fire](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=926859) - Rune - Summon Skeletons - Magic Scroll

title: Cog in The Wheel
description: Chapter 2 How to Start: Talk to [Ian](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=603952) about clearing the collapsed tunnel during [The Minecrawler Nest](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=607663) Quest Quest Steps: - Find the [Cog](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=603966) in one of the cave branches - Bring the Cog to [Ian](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=603952) Reward: - 750 XP - Ore Nugget x25 - Ian's permission to clear the collapsed tunnel ??

title: Beasts of Khorinis V
description: Chapters 4-6 How to Start: Pick up [The Bestiary of Khorinis V](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=713317) Quest Steps: - Bring it to [Cavalorn](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=595691) - Harvest [Frost Shadowbeast's Skin](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=603911) - Report back to [Cavalorn](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=595691) Reward: - 1,500 XP - Extract Spine harvesting Skill

title: Bar the Truth
description: Chapter 3 How to Start: Talk to [Brannok](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=603853) after starting [The Rogues' Camp](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=892215) Quest Quest Steps: - Find [Arlin](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=892384) in the [Old Camp's Dungeons](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=607504). He is in a cage that is really close to [Santino's Dungeon Entrance](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=596148) - Open a locked cell by picking it open or using a Cell Key that's on a guard nearby - Report back to [Brannok](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=603853) Reward: - 250 XP - after finding Arlin - 500 XP - A pass to the [Outlaw Camp](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=603855)[Locked Door - Old Camp's Dungeons](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=596148)

title: Flames to the Flood
description: Chapter 3 - ENDING How to Start: After completing [The Focus Stones](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=889973) Quest talk to [Saturas](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=842102) Quest Steps: - Talk to [Corristo](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=604027) - Talk to [Milten](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=604020) and escape from the camp with him - Report back to [Saturas](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=842102) Reward: - 1,000 XP Next Quest: [Xardas](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=893838)

title: A Shaman Shunned
description: Chapter 4 How to Start: During [Xardas Quest ](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=893838) talk to [Xardas](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=595733) about his plan Quest Steps: - Find and talk to [Ur-Shak](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=893945) in [Old Citadel](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=595735) Reward: - 1,000 XP Next Quest: [The Banner of Banners](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=893946)

title: The Banner of Banners
description: Chapter 4 How to Start: Talk to [Ur-Shak](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=893945) in the Old Citadel Quest Steps: - Find Tarrok in the [Free Mine](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=605433) - Defeat the [Great Troll](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=893949) and collect [Prime Troll Tusk](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=893955) - Defeat [Great Fire Lizard](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=893951) and collect [Prime Tongue of Fire](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=893954) - Defeat [Great Shadowbeast](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=893952) and collect [Horn of a Great Shadow Beast](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=893953) -
