title: By The Hand of a Master
description: Chapter 1-6 How to Start: Master Bow and talk to [Haenno](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=596114) Quest Steps: - Bring a piece of Ironwood, Willow, or Oak wood to [Haenno](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=596114) - Pick up a bow after 24 hours Reward: - 100 XP - Depending on which type of wood is given to Haenno: - Willow Bow - Oak Bow - Ironwood Bow

title: The Orc Enclave
description: Chapter 4 How to Start: Defeat [Tarrok](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=926864) after he's done crafting Ulu-Mulu Quest Steps: - Meet with [Ur-Shak in front of the Enclave](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=926876) Reward: - 2,000 XP Next Quest: [The Path Chosen](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=926878)

title: The Path Chosen
description: Chapters 4-5 How to Start: Talk to [Ur-Shak by the Orc Enclave](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=926876) Quest Steps: - Defeat Grazkrak to get access to the rest of the Orc Enclave - Talk to [Ur-Nazkrog](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=926885) by convincing [Krashok](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=926884) to go through - Complete [A Warrior's Honor](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=926886) Quest - Enter the Sleeper Temple with Ur-Nazkrog Reward: - 300 XP - after defeating Grazkrak - 1,000 XP Next Quests: - [A Warrior's Honor](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=926886) - [The Dreamer's Nightmare](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=926899)

title: A Warrior's Honor
description: Chapter 5 How to Start: Talk to [Ur-Nazkrog](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=926885) Quest Steps: - Talk to Ur-Shak by the entrance to the Sleeper Temple - Collect 3 Orc Spores on orc corpses in the Fighting Ground to get through [Umosh](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=926879) - Perform burial traditions on Grazkrak's body - Report back to [Ur-Nazkrog](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=926885) Reward: - 700 XP

title: Acquired Taste
description: Chapter 5 How to Start: Talk to [Muk](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=926892) while [Umakhal](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=926880) is not around Quest Steps: - Bring Muk a Meatbug Ragout Reward: - 300 XP Note: Using a tunnel in Muk's cave will cause everyone in the Enclave to be hostile if seen by the Temple Warriors

title: The Dreamer's Nightmare
description: Chapter 5 How to Start: Enter The Sleeper Temple for the first time either by completing [A Warrior's Honor](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=926886) Quest or using [Muk's Hidden Tunnel](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=926893) Quest Steps: - Defeat 3 Orc Shamans: - [Varrag Hashor](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=926900) - [Varrag Kasorg](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=926901) - [Varrag Unhilqt](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=926902) - Defeat [Fire Demon](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=926934) - Defeat 2 Orc Shamans: - [Varrag Arushat](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=926904) - [Varrag Ruuushk](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=926903) - Pick up [Strange Sword / Uriziel](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=926960) - Show the sword to [Xardas](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=595733) Reward: - 8,000 XP - after defeating Varrag Hashor - 8,000 XP - after defeating Varrag Kasorg - 8,000 XP - after defeating Varrag Unhilqt - 500 XP - after defeating Fire Demon - 1,500 XP - for 3 Demon Lords - 10,000 XP - after defeating Varrag Arushat - 8,000 XP - after defeating Varrag Ruuushk - 1,000 XP - after talking to Xardas - 2,000 XP Next Quest: [Uriziel](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=926961)

title: Uriziel
description: Chapter 5 How to Start: Show [Uriziel](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=926960) to Xardas at the end of the [The Dreamer's Nightmare](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=926899) Quest Quest Steps: - Talk to Milten in the Saturas' chamber - Talk to Gorn about the guards - Return to Milten - Bribe or kill a guard to get to the Ore Pile - Charge the Uriziel - Return to Xardas Gemstones: - [Worldcleaver](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=926919) - [Lightbringer](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=926923) - [Timesplinter](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=926926) - [Fiendeye](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=926959) - [Banstone](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=926947) Reward: - 5,000 XP - [Charged Uriziel](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=926960) Next Quest: [The Sleeper's Awakening](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=926963)

title: The Sleeper's Awakening
description: Chapter 6 How to Start: Complete [Uriziel](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=926961) Quest Quest Steps: - Reach the last chamber at the end of the [Sleeper Temple](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=595714) - Defeat [Mad Minecrawler Queen](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=926970) - Defeat [Mad Mud](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=926971) - Defeat [Mad Diego](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=926972) - Defeat [Mad Gorn](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=926973) - Defeat [Mad Milten](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=926974) - Defeat [Mad Lester](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=926975) - Defeat [Mad Xardas](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=926976) - Defeat [Mad Demon](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=926977) - Defeat [The Sleeper](https://mapgenie.io/gothic-1-remake/maps/valley-of-mines?locationIds=892231) Reward: - Game is Completed
